author: Anon567655566
quote: Exceptionally distasteful. The story and game mechanics are extraordinarily dissonant to what the gameplay actually is, compared to all previous GTA titles as well. The graphics would have been a slight saving grace, yet it seems to be designed around LIMITING the amount of things you can do apart from being a lawful citizen… in a GTA game for god’s sake. Bugs at release are definitely unpleasant but to me are a bigger sign of rockstar devs focusing on all the wrong things in these 13 years. A grand display of the utter incompetence of the gaming industry. All served gallantly on top of a flaming pile of garbage.
